policies.title: Angolan ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Angola's Foreign Ministry identifies the national ordinary passport as the citizen's document for entering and leaving Angola.
conditions: Applies to an Angolan citizen holding a valid standard national ordinary passport; lawful identity, document, judicial, health, security and border controls remain.

policies.title: Botswana ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Botswana's immigration authority confines the Botswana passport service to Botswana citizens.
conditions: Applies to a Botswana citizen holding a valid standard Botswana passport; lawful identity, document, judicial, health, security and border controls remain.

policies.title: Burkinabè ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: The National Police's ordinary-passport process requires proof of Burkinabè nationality.
conditions: Applies to a Burkinabè national holding a valid standard ordinary passport; lawful identity, document, judicial, health, security and border controls remain.

policies.title: Cameroonian ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Cameroon's national-security authority states that the ordinary passport is issued to Cameroonians.
conditions: Applies to a Cameroonian national holding a valid standard ordinary passport; lawful identity, document, judicial, health, security and border controls remain.

policies.title: Basotho regular-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Lesotho's Passport Act reserves the regular e-passport to citizens and makes it a document for travel into Lesotho.
conditions: Applies to a Lesotho citizen holding a valid regular e-passport; temporary, refugee, official and diplomatic documents are outside this rule.

policies.title: Malian ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Mali's current national AES passport framework and diplomatic service identify the ordinary passport as the citizen's national travel document.
conditions: Applies to a Malian citizen holding a valid national ordinary AES or transition passport; refugee, service and diplomatic documents are outside this rule.

policies.title: Mauritanian ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Mauritania's travel-document decree reserves the national passport to Mauritanian citizens and distinguishes the ordinary class from foreigner and refugee documents.
conditions: Applies to a Mauritanian citizen holding a valid national ordinary passport; foreigner, refugee, service and diplomatic documents are outside this rule.

policies.title: Moroccan biometric-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Morocco's official passport portal confines the biometric passport to Moroccan citizens.
conditions: Applies to a Moroccan citizen holding a valid standard biometric passport; lawful identity, document, judicial, health, security and border controls remain.

policies.title: Nigerien ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Niger's current government launch identifies the ordinary AES passport as a Nigerien document and separately identifies refugee travel documents.
conditions: Applies to a Nigerien citizen holding a valid ordinary passport; refugee, Hajj, service and diplomatic documents are outside this rule.

policies.title: São Toméan passport citizenship
policies.summary: The current Foreign Ministry service under Decree-Law 1/2026 issues passports to São Toméan citizens in the diaspora.
conditions: Applies to a São Toméan citizen holding a valid standard passport; lawful identity, document, judicial, health, security and border controls remain.

policies.title: Senegalese ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: Senegal's citizen-service portal identifies the ordinary passport as issued to Senegalese nationals and separately provides a return safe-conduct.
conditions: Applies to a Senegalese national holding a valid ordinary passport; lawful identity, document, judicial, health, security and border controls remain.

policies.title: Sierra Leonean passport citizenship
policies.summary: Sierra Leone's immigration authority requires proof of citizenship for its passport service.
conditions: Applies to a Sierra Leonean citizen holding a valid standard passport; lawful identity, document, judicial, health, security and border controls remain.

policies.title: South Sudanese ordinary-passport citizenship
policies.summary: South Sudan's Passport and Immigration Act entitles South Sudanese nationals to ordinary passports and cancels the document after nationality renunciation.
conditions: Applies to a South Sudanese national holding a valid ordinary passport; emergency, special and diplomatic documents are outside this rule.

policies.title: Tunisian passport citizenship
policies.summary: Tunisia's current Foreign Ministry e-Consulate requires Tunisian nationality for passport establishment.
conditions: Applies to a Tunisian national holding a valid standard passport; lawful identity, document, judicial, health, security and border controls remain.
